summary.text: Michele Roussel Buckley is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 6, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is an educator and Nashua resident who advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Michele Roussel Buckley earned a high school diploma from Alvirne High School, and her listed career experience is in education.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has taught and mentored children and adults through dance and performing arts education for more than 40 years and founded Gate City Voices, a group intended to encourage civic engagement.
Her Ballotpedia profile lists an endorsement from the National Education Association.

In the same survey, Roussel Buckley said her priorities include strengthening public education, expanding access to affordable healthcare and housing, protecting the environment, supporting local businesses and easing the burden of local property taxes.
She named support for women, children and survivors, education and youth, and neighborhood infrastructure and small businesses as her three key campaign messages.
